opening.argument: The presentation promotes an investment and affiliate structure built around funding accounts, enrolling two people in opposing legs, and pursuing recurring income and 10% referral bonuses. It expressly presents a “binary tree compensation plan” and says participants activate “weekly residual income instantly” that will grow each week. It further makes income dependent on others growing within the participant’s organization, while presenting automatically compounding daily trade income as a program feature. Claims about Bitcoin growth and forex profits are likewise presented as features, but the stated payments and results remain unverified.
